patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
index 6562186..e5a6678 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
@@ -384,6 +384,7 @@ class RunState:
     failure_category: str | None = None
     last_batch_progressed: bool = True
     stagnant_batches: int = 0
+    stop_challenges: int = 0
 
 
 class EnvironmentResult(Protocol):
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..46915f4 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -281,6 +281,25 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
                 )
                 continue
 
+            if (
+                decision.action is ActionKind.STOP
+                and not state.finalization_started
+                and state.stop_challenges < 1
+                and (self._options.max_turns - state.turn_count) > self._options.max_turns // 2
+            ):
+                state.stop_challenges += 1
+                state.unresolved_errors.append(
+                    "Stop rejected: most of the turn budget remains. The task is solvable in "
+                    "this sandbox. Re-read the task, diagnose the blocker with a new "
+                    "hypothesis (check installed tools, file formats, alternative approaches), "
+                    "and keep working. Stop again only if truly impossible."
+                )
+                self._journal.append(
+                    "stop_challenged",
+                    {"turns_remaining": self._options.max_turns - state.turn_count},
+                )
+                continue
+
             if decision.action is ActionKind.EXECUTE:
                 if state.finalization_started:
                     state.finalization_repair_used = True
